title: Induced poset saturation in the hypergrid
summary: Set $[n]=\{1, 2, \ldots , n\}$. The hypergrid $[t]^n$ is the collection of functions $f: \ [n]\rightarrow [t]$. We equip it with the natural partial order by letting $f\leq g$ whenever $f(x)\leq g(x)$ holds for all $x\in [n]$. Given a poset $P$ which can be embedded as an induced subposet of $[t]^n$, the induced poset saturation function $\mathrm{sat}^{\star}([t]^n, P)$ denotes the minimum size of a subset of $[t]^n$ that is both induced $P$-free and induced $P$-saturated.
